# Built-in services

The status pages HealthBar lists in Settings, checked 2026-11-15. ✓ in *Default* means checked on first launch. *History* is whether the page publishes the per-day data behind the 30-day strip; without it the menu shows “No uptime history”. Any other Statuspage or incident.io page can be added by its address.
